**The implementation is incomplete and should not yet be used as a drop-in BibTeX replacement.** Name formatting, TeX special-character handling, exact `width$` behavior, cross-reference processing, error locations, and warning behavior still need work. Byte-for-byte parity with the four canonical styles has not been verified.
